page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening) with one text column; a narrow column of marginal fragments at the right edge of the scan belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed. Braces and bracketed diagrams in the text are rendered as outlines. Running head at top left and right; page number centred above the head.

main_text.p: Huius sacramenti ad plenum nutrimentum obsignandum, & Christi mortem continuò annunciandam duo membra: Primum, de pane. Secundū, de vino. Ibid. Ioa.6. 1.Cor.11.26.
main_text.l: In primo membro: Actiones externae: Administrantis. Recipientis.
main_text.p: Administrantis sunt, vt εὐλογία siue consecratione peracta, panem frangat, fractūq; tradat, dicens, accipite, comedite, hoc est corpus Christi, i. veri corporis sacramentum.Mat.26.26.Mar.14.24.Luc.23. 19.1.Cor.10.16.
Recipientis, vt reuerenter manu accipiant, & comedant, ad corporis nutrimentum.Ibid.
main_text.l: Actiones internae sunt: Tribuentis Dei. Recipientis.
main_text.p: Tribuentis Dei, Christum a patre obsignatum, corpus verum pro peccatis contritum, ad spirituale ἀνάγνωσιν omnibus offerentis, veris autem christianis exhibentis.Mat.26.26.Marc.14.22. Luc.22.19. 1.Cor. 10,16.

Recipientis, est fide, Christi corpus, & ita Christum cum tota ecclesia recipere, & sibi applicare, vt inde, tum ijs quae iustificationem, tum quae sanctificationem spectant, magis magisq; nutriatur. 1.Cor. 10.16.17. 1.Cor.12.13.

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge belong to the facing page. Text of the outline (braces) is partly reconstructed from the layout; the Greek words are copied as far as legible. Ibid. note beside the first brace is a marginal note of the left page.
